description: Task-driven recommendations; the main agent confirms the selection after reading the actual task.

fullstack-analytics.title: Analytics + dashboard + workflow
fullstack-analytics.notes: If the task contains no optimization, replace the optimization agent with backend-engineer. Keep backend/auth/integration under main otherwise.

prediction-ml.title: Forecasting, machine learning and evaluation
prediction-ml.notes: Prioritize split discipline, leakage detection, sensible baseline, and decision rationale. Add frontend-engineer if the UI is a hard requirement.

optimization-operations.title: Optimization, scheduling, routing and allocation
optimization-operations.notes: Define hard constraints separately from soft objectives; verify independently; compare against a baseline. Use frontend agent instead of verification if dashboard is mandatory, with main owning independent verification.

web-product.title: User-facing web application and design
web-product.notes: Only install React-specific skills if the chosen stack is React/Next.js. Avoid elaborate visuals before acceptance criteria are met.

data-engineering.title: ETL/ELT, databases, data quality and SQL
data-engineering.notes: Select DB-specific guidance only after the DB engine is established. Test ingestion idempotence, lineage and rollback.

agent-automation.title: Agentic workflow, tool orchestration and automation
agent-automation.notes: MCP Builder only when an MCP server is required. No external AI service or model connection.

document-intelligence.title: PDF/XLSX/DOCX extraction and reporting
document-intelligence.notes: Install document-format skills only for actual input/output formats. Extract source evidence and reconcile totals.

backend-service.title: APIs, persistence, authentication, integrations
backend-service.notes: Emphasize server-side authorization, persistence, validation, restart/transaction behavior and deployable local runtime.

algorithmic.title: Algorithms, computation and exact correctness
algorithmic.notes: Compare against reference solutions on small cases, challenge edge cases and benchmark worst-case complexity.

simulation-decision.title: Simulation, scenarios and decision support
simulation-decision.notes: Separate historical observations, assumptions and simulated scenarios. Show intervals and sensitivity instead of precise-sounding guesses.

security-audit.title: Secure architecture, threat model and code review
security-audit.notes: No exfiltration, no external scanning target, no exploit tools. Review only the in-scope local system.

impeccable.scope: Frontend work only; avoid Computer Use and browser automation

web-design-guidelines.requires: Frontend project, network read for guidelines; no task data upload

property-based-testing.requires: Testable invariants; no compulsory extra dependencies

mcp-builder.requires: MCP server implementation, not external model connection
